name: YouTube Dislike for Safari
subtitle: Estimated dislikes in Safari
description:
See estimated YouTube dislike counts while browsing in Safari. YouTube Dislike uses data from the independent Return YouTube Dislike service. Estimates are marked with ≈ and are not official YouTube counts.

Open the Safari toolbar popup to see likes and estimated dislikes for the current video. On iPhone and iPad, you can also share a YouTube video link to YouTube Dislike to view its statistics.

New vote submission to Return YouTube Dislike is enabled by default. You can turn it off in the Safari extension settings. Sharing a link only retrieves statistics and never submits a vote.

Requires enabling the Safari extension and allowing access to YouTube and the RYD API. The Safari extension does not run inside the YouTube app. Availability depends on the third-party service and YouTube page compatibility.

Free, with no in-app purchases. Independent of YouTube, Google and Return YouTube Dislike.
reviewNotes: Enable the extension in Safari settings and grant access to YouTube and returnyoutubedislikeapi.com. Open a public YouTube video in Safari. The native dislike button shows an estimated count. The toolbar popup has two counters. Vote submission controls are on the extension options page. On iOS/iPadOS, share a YouTube link and select YouTube Dislike to retrieve statistics without voting. No app login is required to retrieve statistics. YouTube voting requires the user's own YouTube session. No purchases, ads, app account or developer-operated backend. No review submission is requested in this preparation stage.
